name: Foodlink F&B Holdings
summary: Luxury events caterer, casual dining chain (China Bistro, Art of Dum) and banquet operator with 7 centralized kitchens; fresh issue ₹192 Cr plus OFS of up to 88.35 lakh shares; price band not yet in the RHP.
financials: FY26 revenue ₹567.50 Cr (+25.9%), EBITDA ₹78.43 Cr (13.82%), PAT ₹29.11 Cr, borrowings ₹24.29 Cr excl. leases; H1 FY27 PAT loss ₹16.15 Cr
quota: QIB not less than 75% · NII not more than 15% · Retail not more than 10% (RHP Offer Structure)
positives: Revenue +19.5% FY25, +25.9% FY26; PAT from ₹15.35 Cr loss (FY24) to ₹29.11 Cr; operating cash flow positive every period
Claimed largest organised luxury caterer in India (FY25); 7 kitchens and exclusive F&B mandates
Borrowings only ₹22.38 Cr at Sep 2026 (excl. ₹97.10 Cr leases)
red_flags: H1 FY27 loss ₹16.15 Cr, EBITDA margin 7.35%; profits seasonal and recent
₹113.71 Cr of fresh issue is capex with no sites, approvals or orders; UAE conflict hurt business
No listed peers, company-commissioned industry report; receivables ₹17.74 Cr → ₹60.05 Cr in two years
anchor: Pending — anchor bidding not yet held
